en.name: Barista
en.ability: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy and gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.

revisions.v1: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy and gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.

zh.name: 咖啡师
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，直至下个黄昏，由说书人二选一：1）一名玩家解除并免受醉酒和中毒影响，且会得知正确信息；2）一名玩家的能力可以生效两次。该玩家会得知是哪个效果。
